annotations.title: Agents in vaults, ranked by result

description: AI agents that deposit into DeFi vaults, ranked by what they made or lost: per agent the vaults, dollars in and out, the position read at the vault now, the result (position + withdrawn − deposited) and the return on what went in. sort=result (default), return (from $100 deposited) or worst. A result is stated only where the position was read and our history starts with a deposit. FREE.

sort.description: result: most made first; return: best return on deposits, from $100 in; worst: most lost first.

name: agent_vault_leaderboard

agents.description: Agent addresses with deposits or withdrawals in vaults we read.

means.description: What the figures are and what they leave out.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

rows.description: One row per agent address, ranked.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withResult.description: Of those, how many have a stated result (position read, history starting with a deposit).
